review:
Zombie Carnival brings undead performers to a circus tent on a 4x6 layout. Pragmatic Play's description is brief: the brain symbol is the scatter and the gateway to free spins, and the game offers wins of up to 5,000x the stake.

With few details published about the feature mechanics, the demo is the best way to understand how the bonus plays out and whether it suits you. The RTP is 96.5%, Pragmatic Play's standard top setting. It's a quirky horror-themed game, best suited to players who enjoy offbeat themes and don't mind discovering the features by playing.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
